Road conditions

  • (877)WVA-ROAD-Road conditions
  • http://www.wvdot.com/14_roadconditions/14_roadcond.cfm (Road conditions chart)
  • http://www.wvdot.com/6_motorists/alertzones/ (Road construction chart)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide, over 13'6" high, trailer over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Overhang; mfg. model/serial of load; driver name; if mobile home, wt. of load

Times Of Movement

  • Sunrise-sunset for vehicles 14’ or less, 75’ or less long, 10’ or less overhand, 14’ or less high 7 days a week
  • Travel only on Interstate or APD routes w/ dimensions less than 14’ wide, 95’ long, 15’ overhang, 14’6” high sunrise-sunset, 7 days/week
  • Oversize vehicles exceeding these dimensions up to & including 16’ wide can travel sunrise-sunset, M-F
  • Oversize vehicles exceeding 16’ wide may only travel on Sunday mornings
  • Overweight vehicles up to & including 110,000lbs. may travel 24/7
  • Overweight exceeding 110,000lbs. can travel sunrise-sunset, M-F
  • May run Sat. & Sun., but must be requested when permit is ordered
  • Restricted holidays: New Years Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.wvdot.com/3_roadways/3_files/permitinformation.doc

On 2-Lane Highways:

  • Width over 10'6" to 12’-1 front, 7 days
  • Over 12' to 14’ wide-2 (front & rear), 7 days
  • Over 14’ to 15' wide-2 (front & rear) M-F
  • Over 15’ to 16’ wide-3 (2 front & 1 rear)
  • Width over 16'-as required by permit-Sunday (must be accompanied by WV DOT),
  • Length over 75'-95’ -1 rear, M-F
  • Over 95' long to 100’-2 (front & rear), M-F
  • Over 100’ long-2 (front & rear), M-F
  • Overhang over 10' (front)-1 front, M-F
  • Overhang over 10' (rear)-1 rear, M-F
  • Height over 15'-1 front w/pole in addition to any other escort

4 Or More Lane Highways:

  • Width over 12’ to 14'-1 rear, 7 days
  • Width over 14' to 15’-2 (front & rear), M-F (except WV Parkway Authority: M-Th & Sun. until noon; no movement Fri.)
  • Width over 15' to 16’-3 (1 front & 2 rear), same as above
  • Width over 16'-same as 2-lane except over 16’ not allowed on Parkway
  • Length over 95'-100’-1 rear, M-F
  • Length over 100'-2 (front & rear), M-F
  • Overhang over 10' (front)-1 front, M-F
  • Overhang over 10' (rear)-1 rear, M-F
  • Height over 15’-1 front w/ pole in addition to other pilots required (Parkway (I-77/64) Yeager Bridge-max. height 15’10”)

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Signs: signs/placards (min. 8” x 12”) showing name of company or owner or driver (also, phone #) in a conspicuous place on both sides of vehicle
  • Lights: Rotating/strobe amber plastic or acrylic or glass covered flashing light—visible at least 500’ & 360o
  • Bumper mounted or roof mounted “Oversize Load” signs: 5’ x 12” black letter 10” high, 1½” wide brush strokes visible front & rear
  • Flags: 2 flags (red or safety orange), 18” square; mounted 40o-70o angle on vehicle’s roof racks or on all four corners of the vehicle
  • Additional equipment: CB radio or any other two-way communication device
  • 2 5lb. fire extinguishers (type A,B,C)
  • “Stop”/”Slow” sign w/ paddle not less than 18” in diameter w/ 6“ letters
  • Safety orange vest/shirt/jacket to wear when directing traffic
  • Red hand-held flag (18”)
  • 2 “Oversize Load” banners (yellow w/ black letters)
  • 3 reflecting triangles or 18” traffic cones
  • Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator N/A
